result.summary: Several layout and truncation issues make restaurant cards and category filters look broken or incomplete, with cut-off names, clipped carousels, and partially visible content.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated in the Fastest near you section, cutting off the full name.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line titles, reduce font size, or ensure card width accommodates typical restaurant name lengths without ellipsis mid-word.

issues.description: Horizontal carousels (category chips and Fastest near you cards) are clipped at the right edge with no clear peek/fade, making content look cut off.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent right padding/safe area and a partial next-card peek so users can tell the row is scrollable.

issues.description: The bottom restaurant card (pizza with -20% badge) is heavily cut off by the tab bar, so only part of the image and controls are visible.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset/padding equal to the tab bar height so cards are fully visible when scrolling ends.

issues.description: Delivery time badges sit overlapping the food images with uneven placement and contrast across cards.
issues.suggestion: Standardize badge position, padding, and background opacity so labels remain legible and aligned on every card.

issues.description: Category filter row ends abruptly with a partial chip on the right, which looks unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the last visible chip peeks cleanly or add a fade/scroll affordance for remaining categories.
